answer_1.quote: Dialog systems are designed to engage in natural language conversations with users, provide relevant information, answer queries, and simulate human interactions.

answer_2.quote: For quantitative comparison, we assess the generated datasets using diverse reference-free metrics that gauge distinct aspects of the dialog or generated questions.
automatic_metrics: Pang et al. (2020) GPT-2 based dialog metric

answer_3.quote: Additionally, when utilizing GPT-4 as an NLG evaluator, our model consistently outperforms the baseline, confirming its superior performance.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 100 dialogs from the generated datasets and conduct a relative comparison through both human and GPT-4.
answer_4.guideline: For both evaluations, we use three criteria, i.e., contextual relevance, well-formedness, and overall quality, according to the characteristics of the ConvQA task and existing research.
